column1: # Mutants of the code docs/declared-topology-audit.md reads: each one makes
# one declaration wrong, by declaring a side single that has two or more
# threads (kind a: by a flag or an explicit sp/sc call) or by adding a
# second thread to a side declared single (kind b, DPDK; kind c, a
# library's single-producer single-consumer type). An added thread runs on
# an lcore nothing else runs on (a launch on a busy lcore fails with
# -EBUSY), or is an existing thread given a second role; every wrong
# declaration is reached by two threads at once in the run the last column
# names. No edit adds or removes a line,
# so the creation sites keep their positions.
